DIAGNOSIS READY: Auriculotemporal Neuralgia (Tic d'Éole)

The shooting pain triggered by chewing and the tenderness around the ear canal (difficulty with earrings) following your tympanoplasty are classic signs of auriculotemporal neuralgia. Given your history of chronic ear infections and recent surgery, this is likely a complication involving nerve regeneration or irritation.
